questions.q: Can a single standard or custom object have more than one page layout?
options: No, every object is limited to exactly one page layout
Yes — it's common for an object to have several, each tuned to a different audience or process
Only custom objects can have multiple page layouts, never standard ones
Only if Multiple Currencies is activated
questions.explain: The lesson's Case example shows six page layouts on one object, each built for a different kind of case.

questions.q: Which of the following is controlled by a page layout?
options: Which fields appear, whether they're required, which related lists show, and which buttons/actions are available
Which users can log in during business hours
The org's fiscal year start month
Which currencies are active in the org
questions.explain: A page layout determines field visibility/requiredness/arrangement, related lists, and buttons/links/quick actions on a record.

questions.q: What does the Page Layout Assignment screen actually map?
options: Users to Business Hours records
Record type and profile combinations to a specific page layout
Currencies to conversion rates
Apps to their default navigation items
questions.explain: Page Layout Assignment maps each record type + profile combination to a layout — either one layout for all profiles or a different layout per profile.

questions.q: In most orgs today, how does a Lightning record page's Record Detail component relate to page layouts?
options: It completely replaces page layouts and ignores them
It still pulls its field content from the assigned page layout underneath it, unless upgraded to Dynamic Forms
It requires Apex code to render any fields at all
Page layouts and Lightning record pages cannot coexist in the same org
questions.explain: The lesson explains that the Record Detail component on a Lightning record page still draws its fields from the assigned page layout, unless that page has been upgraded to Dynamic Forms.

questions.q: A page layout arranges the same set of fields into either one column or two columns. What does the lesson say this choice affects?
options: Nothing visible — column count is purely cosmetic metadata with no user-facing effect
How much scrolling a user does to see everything on the record
Whether the record can be saved at all
Which profile can access the record
questions.explain: The lesson shows the same fields rendered in two columns versus stacked in one column, noting that the arrangement changes how much scrolling is needed to see everything.
